prompts:
Edit/reference role: the supplied image is the EXACT style, color and coordinate template of a modular female RPG head base. Produce ONE SPRITE ATLAS, exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows, equal square cells, 2048x1024. TRANSPARENT RGBA background. No labels, grid lines, text or decorations. Each cell replicates the template's 512x512 coordinate system. Only BALD, FEATURELESS adult female heads with ears and a straight neck. No eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, hair or clothing: the central face plane must remain smooth blank skin, with no phantom facial features. Skin palette identical warm ivory and muted upper-left shading as reference; medium-detail semi-realistic anime painting.
Make EIGHT STRONGLY DISTINCT FEMININE CRANIOFACIAL SHAPES. Differences must remain obvious in silhouette and cheek shading even after identical eyes and hair are overlaid. Do NOT draw eight copies of the same pointed oval.
Row 1 left to right:
1 ROUND: broad full cheeks, softly rounded wide jaw, short rounded chin, broad low forehead. Definitely circular lower outline, NOT pointed V chin.
2 SQUARE: strong broad mandibular angles, broad flat chin, moderately broad forehead; elegant athletic adult woman. Distinct jaw corners, not oval.
3 HEART: broad upper forehead and temples, cheeks tapering sharply to a small delicate pointed chin. Subtle cheekbone shadow.
4 DIAMOND: relatively narrow forehead and temples, pronounced HIGH WIDE cheekbones at y245, hollow shading below cheekbones, angular narrowing jaw and small chin.
Row 2 left to right:
5 LONG RECTANGULAR: tall broad forehead, long straight side planes, lean cheeks, straight-sided rectangular jaw and flatter chin.
6 PEAR: narrow forehead and temples, broader lower cheeks and fuller wide rounded lower jaw, soft chin.
7 HIGH CHEEKBONES: sculpted angular prominent cheekbones, visibly hollow cheeks, tapered but broad flat chin, strong mature adult bone structure, balanced forehead.
8 SOFT FULL: plump lower cheeks and a softly padded broad rounded chin, smooth jaw curve, domed wide forehead, distinct fuller face.
GEOMETRY MUST BE LOCKED. Per 512x512 cell: center x256. Head crown y50; chin bottom y338 ±6. Eye sockets will later be placed at x202 and x307 y235; leave that zone BLANK. Ears at x137..164 and x348..375, y200..264. Temples fit within x143..369; cheeks vary from width190 to260 around x256; jaw widths deliberately vary130..210. Neck connects under jaw and uses the EXACT reference neck position, side boundaries x196 and x316 at y365, bottom y430. Keep neck short in appearance, NO shoulders/flaring base. Neck bottom horizontal. Entire content stays inside each cell. All eight heads must align at the same eye line, chin line and neck socket. Anatomical shading on forehead/cheekbones/jaw should describe the different bones, but never draw eyes/nose/mouth. Preserve same contour weight and skin color as supplied. Real alpha transparency outside sprites, clean edges.

Background extraction ONLY. Remove the entire gray/white checkerboard background from this 8-head atlas and return actual transparent PNG RGBA with alpha=0 outside heads. The checkerboard is unwanted drawn pixels, NOT transparency. Keep all eight skin heads, ears and necks pixel-aligned and preserve exactly their shapes, warm skin colors, shading, 4-column 2-row layout, framing, proportions and featureless faces. No checkerboard, no gray, white or black background, no shadows outside heads, no texture outside heads. Real empty alpha background. Do not modify heads, do not move them, do not add eyes, eyebrows, noses, lips or hair.
importNote: The generated atlas contained a neutral checker matte. The deterministic import pipeline extracts warm skin silhouettes, aligns crown/chin, preserves the canonical neck socket and writes validated RGBA PNGs.
